carried_unit.contract: Virtual rigid side-carry adapter for kinematic assembly, not an upstream gripper or validated physical grasp. Opening is TCP + (-140, 0, 60) mm; a +90 degree local-Y rotation maps unit longitudinal +X to source TCP -Z. No adapter solid, gripping dynamics or hardware calibration is claimed.

scenario.description: Upright laboratory fixture facing the robot: world opening at (0.55, -0.10, -0.12) m, world RPY (0, 0, 180) degrees. Station pose limits disabled explicitly; full assembly motion, limits and collision validation remain mandatory.
